newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan welcomes NATO-Russia security accord.
newsitem.headline: Japan welcomes NATO-Russia security accord.

text.p: Japan said on Wednesday it welcomed the signing by NATO and Russia of an historic accord on a new security relationship.
"I'm glad it was signed," Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told reporters.
"We will pay attention to how changes expected to take place in Europe will affect Asia," he said.

In Paris on Tuesday, leaders of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO) and Russian President Boris Yeltsin signed the Founding Act on Mutual Relations designed to bind Russia into efforts to create a new European security order.
